text:
Maya S: OrionPay wants a 2-week POC to swap out VendorX. Primary asks: prompt parity, output format, and enterprise SSO/KMS. Can we be near drop-in?
Alex P: Mostly yes. Key caveats: tokenization differences (affects billing), default sampling leading to response drift, and streaming framing mismatch.
Maya S: Need specifics for the SOW.
Alex P: Short list: 1) Token counts differ -> include normalization layer; 2) Sampling defaults differ -> lock temperature/top_p in shim; 3) VendorX streams with `data:` frames, Redwood uses event chunks -> shim must reframe.
Devon R: Security: they require BYOK and Azure AD SSO. Our Private supports customer KMS + SAML/OIDC but POC needs network egress/IP allowlist and audit export.
Jordan L: Pricing Q: 100k tokens/day over 14 days. Suggest hosted with prepaid credits or a tiny Dedicated burst commit for tail-latency tests? Thoughts?
Priya K: Recommend hosted prepaid credits + option to enable Dedicated burst for perf tests. That avoids committing to monthly reserved capacity.
Maya S: Legal asked about data retention and audit logs for the POC. Devon can we expose tenant-scoped audit exports?
Devon R: Yes. We can enable per-tenant audit logs and S3/SIEM export. Webhooks will HMAC-sign payloads; we'll need their collector IPs for allowlisting.
Alex P: Proposed POC plan: 1) lightweight shim adapter to normalize surface, 2) shared evaluation prompt set and automated scoring, 3) A/B runs vs VendorX, capture latency/cost/quality deltas.
Maya S: Example shim mapping?
Alex P: ````
# shim example (pseudo)
POST /vendorx/generate -> POST /redwood/v1/generate
payload.input = normalize_tokens(payload.prompt)
headers['x-tenant'] = "orionpay"
query.sample_temp = 0.0
````
Alex P: Keep it minimal: token normalization, deterministic sampling, and streaming frame translation.
Jordan L: Will call out token normalization in the SOW to clarify billing. Also include clause for fallback to quantized model and associated cost delta.
Priya K: POC deliverables: setup guide, shim repo, eval harness (10 canonical prompts + scoring scripts), SSO/KMS runbook, cost model. I'll own the repo.
SecBot: Security questionnaire artifact: https://internal.redwood/sec-templates/pci-poc-checklist (automated scan scheduled).
Maya S: Next steps: Alex/Priya pair on shim by EOD tomorrow, Devon to draft Azure AD/KMS integration note, Jordan to propose POC pricing options. I'll assemble presales deck.
Alex P: Acknowledged. I'll drop a minimal shim template in the sales drive and tag @Maya S. :thumbsup:
Devon R: Starting Azure AD notes now. Will flag infra changes if needed.
Jordan L: DMing finance for quote matrix.
Priya K: Creating repo + initial eval set, ETA EOD tomorrow.
Maya S: Goal: have POC scoping into OrionPay by Friday for kickoff.
